name: Palacio Duhau - Park Hyatt Buenos Aires
insider_take: This palatial retreat seamlessly blends aristocratic heritage with contemporary luxury in the heart of Recoleta, where French elegance meets Argentine sophistication.
whats_special: The hotel uniquely spans two historic buildings - a restored 1930s neoclassical palace and a modern tower - connected by an underground art-filled tunnel. The original Palacio Duhau was once home to one of Argentina's most influential families, and many original features including marble staircases, crystal chandeliers, and period frescoes remain intact. The property sits directly across from the famous Recoleta Cemetery where Eva Perón rests.
pro_tip: Book a Palacio room in the historic wing for authentic period details, or request a Park Tower room facing the cemetery for fascinating views and perfect sunset lighting over Buenos Aires' most famous necropolis.
dont_miss: The underground Cheese & Wine Bar features an impressive selection of Argentine wines in a sophisticated cellar setting. Take afternoon tea in the Oak Bar surrounded by original wood paneling, and explore the hotel's impressive contemporary art collection displayed throughout the connecting tunnel between buildings.
pros: Historic palace architecture combined with contemporary luxury amenities
Prime location in prestigious Recoleta neighborhood near cultural attractions
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
World-class spa and wellness facilities with comprehensive treatments
Outstanding fine dining restaurants featuring local and international cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers seeking casual experiences
